title: Code of Criminal Procedure Amendment Act 2004

sections.shortTitle: Code of Criminal Procedure Amendment Act 2004
sections.description:
Short title, and commencement

ACT VI OF 2004
ACT VI OF 2004
CODE OF CRIMINAL
PROCEDURE (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2004
An Act further to
amend the ,Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 12th October, 2004]
F‑9(9)/2004‑Legis.,
dated 11‑10‑2004.‑‑‑The following Act of
Majlis‑e‑Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President
on 5th October, 2004, is hereby published for general information:‑‑
Whereas, it is expedient further
to amend the Code of `Criminal Procedure, 1898 (Act V of 1898) for the purposes
hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:‑
1. Short title, and
commencement.‑--(1) This Act may be called the Code of Criminal
Procedure (Amendment) Act, 2004.
(2) It shall come into force at once
